assets.productionStatus: Concept images only; model and runtime production remain open
assets.tierConceptRepresents: Illustrative equipped layouts after research and paid construction; not starting equipment

verticalExpansion.laterTiers: Tier 7 encloses the retained stack instead of adding a deck. Tiers beyond 7 remain to be designed and require their own research, structure and balance.
verticalExpansion.powerAndLogisticsTravelVia: reinforced central service spine and structural trunks

structuralEnclosure.shape: Broad central hull, enclosed radial connectors, solid stepped deck rims and continuous walls joining the existing elevations
structuralEnclosure.visualReference: Starfleet-style starbase solidity and broad engineered silhouette, adapted to the existing human station family
structuralEnclosure.integralVolume: Structural hull, access passages, permanent docking bays and unassigned enclosed space; fixed docking is inherited from the core, while optional habitat, cargo, shipyard and weapon modules remain separate
structuralEnclosure.moduleClearanceRule: Preserve open interfaces and access envelopes around all fitted modules and empty sockets; block the enclosure order if geometry conflicts cannot be resolved without moving or hiding existing equipment

builtInDocking.bayForm: Permanent recessed outer-hull berth with fixed docking clamp assemblies and a station airlock
mechanisms: rigid docking clamps engaging supported ship fixtures
alignment collar sealing to the ship side hatch
personnelTransferRequires: valid ship and station access permission
builtInDocking.failureBehavior: Stop transfer and show blocked state when support, seal, docking authorization or route conditions fail; never animate personnel through an unconnected tunnel
builtInDocking.optionalDockingModules: Separately researched expansions add more berths or specialized traffic, cargo or service capability. Baseline docking and personnel access remain part of the core.
builtInDocking.tier7Rule: Preserve open recessed bay entrances, clamp sweep and telescope clearances through the enclosure. Block construction that conflicts with a docked ship or active boarding route.
